Question: The context states that Ce co-doping narrows the optical band gap of TiO2 from 2.90 eV down to 2.20-2.46 eV, with the smallest value (2.20 eV) at Ce 0.2. Does the Tauc plot in Figure 4c support this claim?
Answer in at most five sentences.

key.answer_key: No. On the Tauc plot (F4c), the linear fit lines for the doped samples are drawn through the sub-edge tail region, around hv ~2.3-2.9 eV, which carries the Er absorption line near 2.37 eV, rather than through the main absorption edge near 3 eV. So the extrapolated band-gap values come from fitting this sub-edge tail/Er feature, not from the true TiO2 absorption edge, which undercuts the claimed narrowing.
